services.title: Core HR & Global Human Resources
services.leadDescription: Architect a single source of truth for global workforce structures, person models, and automated employee journeys.
services.paragraph: Oracle Fusion Cloud Core HR allows organizations to manage their global workforce from hire to retire with unparalleled clarity. Our certified functional consultants configure robust enterprise structures, position trees, and compliance rules. We ensure seamless employee and manager self-service, localized compliance across international borders, and integrated guided journeys that simplify everyday HR interactions.

services.title: Oracle Fusion Payroll & Compensation
services.leadDescription: Automate localized multi-country payroll calculations, retroactive processing, and strategic total compensation.
services.paragraph: Ensure accurate, on-time, and fully compliant compensation for your workforce with Oracle Fusion Global Payroll. We design complex Fast Formulas, setup retroactive pay processes, and integrate seamlessly with third-party banking networks. Our compensation experts tailor merit cycles, bonus distribution, and salary basis architectures to retain top performers.

services.title: Time & Labor and Absence Management
services.leadDescription: Streamline shift scheduling, multi-tier approvals, complex leave accruals, and regulatory compliance.
services.paragraph: Manage diverse employee schedules, attendance capture, and localized leave rules effortlessly. We configure customized time card layouts, rule templates, and accrual plans tailored to collective bargaining agreements or regional statutory regulations. Integrated approval workflows and delegation matrices ensure management decisions remain frictionless.

services.title: Talent Management & Recruiting (ORC)
services.leadDescription: Attract high-caliber talent, align employee objectives, and cultivate future leaders with intelligent HCM.
services.paragraph: From candidate sourcing with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC) to goal alignment and succession planning, we build interconnected talent ecosystems. Foster employee growth with continuous feedback, AI-assisted candidate matching, talent review calibration meetings, and integrated Oracle Learning Cloud courses.

services.title: Redwood UI & Visual Builder Studio (VBS)
services.leadDescription: Customize and elevate your Oracle HCM user interface using Redwood design standards and VBS business rules.
services.paragraph: Transform your user experience with Oracle Redwood UI. Our technical team leverages Oracle Visual Builder Studio (VBS) to build bespoke page extensions, configure Express & Advanced Business Rules, and create intuitive guided workflows that fit your exact corporate identity while maintaining 100% upgrade safety.

services.title: HCM Integrations & BI Reporting
services.leadDescription: Execute robust data migrations, automated outbound extracts, and actionable enterprise BI analytics.
services.paragraph: Bridge Oracle Fusion HCM with your entire IT landscape. We engineer high-throughput data loads via HCM Data Loader (HDL/HSDL), automated payroll and benefits outbound files using HCM Extracts, real-time REST API orchestrations via OIC, and executive dashboards with OTBI & BI Publisher.

whyCvTabs.title: The Vantage Advantage
whyCvTabs.heading: 20+ Years of Oracle Cloud Mastery
whyCvTabs.body: Founded by industry veterans with extensive real-world experience, we don't just implement software; we architect scalable solutions that map precisely to your business objectives across real estate, healthcare, and logistics sectors.

whyCvTabs.title: Global Delivery Model
whyCvTabs.heading: Onshore Strategy, Offshore Precision
whyCvTabs.body: Headquartered in Madurai with state-of-the-art offshore delivery centers in Chennai and Madurai, India. This hybrid model guarantees enterprise-grade architectural design coupled with highly cost-effective, round-the-clock technical execution and support.

whyCvTabs.title: Cross-Sector Expertise
whyCvTabs.heading: Built for Complex Environments
whyCvTabs.body: We specialize in deploying Oracle Fusion modules in industries with rigid compliance, massive workforces, and intricate supply chains. Whether it is oil & gas drilling or retail pharmacy, we know how to configure the cloud for your reality.

team.name: Jeevanantham R.
